# Myst

Myst is styled after an IntelliJ color palette, with animated title accents and a pen icon that signals editing. It sets the S-CoreDream-3Light font, adds H2 underlines to separate sections, and shows folder icons with color accents for clearer hierarchy.

![Myst screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mulder3062/Myst/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Myst"
    author: "mulder3062"
    repo:   "mulder3062/Myst"
    slug:   "myst"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/myst"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/mulder3062/Myst"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mulder3062/Myst/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Style Obsidian with an IntelliJ-inspired color palette, animated title accents and a pen icon to signal editing. Use S-CoreDream-3Light font, add H2 underlines for section separation, and show folder icons with color accents for clearer hierarchy."
}
```
